#5697: Mae Mai Mild Crispy Garlic & Onion – United States

  • * Stars 4.1 - 5.0
  • Mae Mai
  • Other
  • United States
November 6, 2026 Hans "The Ramen Rater" Lienesch No comments

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:04
Instaread

I’ve got to say I’m thrilled about this stuff. They were kind enough to send this pouch version as well as a cannister version of the same thing. I’d show that one, but it’s almost gone. I’ve used it one ramen recently as well as mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, and even put a little in a quesadilla. It’s good – let’s take a look!

Mae Mai Mild Crispy Garlic & Onion – United States

Detail of the packaging (click to enlarge). To prepare, sprinkle on anything you want and enjoy!

An amount of garlic and onion.

Finished (click to enlarge). Added Mae Mai Mild and a little scallion to Maruchan Creamy Chicken Ramen Noodle Soup. The garlic and onion are crisp and flavorful – and sweet and oily. It’s highly addictive and goes well on so many things. I haven’t evangelized a product for ramen toppings so much since I initially discovered Lao Gan Ma chili crisp. It’s perfect. 5.0 out of 5.0 stars. UPC bar code 86000900365.

Amazon – get it here
